name: migrate-to-hydrogen-2026-10
description: Migrate a classic Hydrogen storefront (Remix or React Router 7) to Hydrogen 2026-10 (`@shopify/hydrogen@^2026.10.0`), where Hydrogen is a server-handler library you compose instead of a framework that owns the request. Use when the user asks to migrate or upgrade a Hydrogen storefront to Hydrogen 2026-10 ("migrate to hydrogen 2026-10", "migrate to hydrogen preview", "upgrade Hydrogen to the new library").
